title: Daily Perfecting Nourishing Lotion

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Lotions & Body Oils > Body Moisturizers > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A body lotion that does more than just moisturize with a fast-absorbing formula that nourishes skin for a subtle, healthy-looking glow.


Skincare Concerns: Dryness


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Avocado Oil: A nutrient-dense oil that boosts the skin’s moisture barrier and helps neutralize free radicals.

- Apple Fruit Extract: A fast-acting humectant that rapidly attracts moisture.

- Light Reflecting Pearl: Provides an instant, subtle sheen to skin.


Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply all over your body whenever you need a boost of moisture.
-Gently massage until blended.
Ingredients+

-Blend of Natural Oils: A naturally derived oil blend that gently cleanses, smooths, and nourishes skin.

-Glycerin: A trustworthy hydrator that attracts and retains moisture.

-Vitamin E: A natural antioxidant that supports the skin’s moisture barrier and helps defend against free radicals.


Water/Aqua/Eau, Propanediol, C13-15 Alkane, Glycerin, Pyrus Malus (Apple) Fruit Extract, Cetearyl Alcohol, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Fragrance/Parfum, 1,2-Hexandiol, Arachidyl Alcohol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Arachidyl Glucoside, Glucose, Hydroxyacetophenone, Behenyl Alcohol, Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer, Sodium Phytate, Citric Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Linalool, Hexyl Cinnamal, Geraniol, Limonene, Citronellol, Citral, Farnesol.
